### Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", basic_config$Type, " / ", basic_config$Level, " / ", basic_config$Name, " / R = ", basic_config$Radius))


```

```{r}

# ==== TEST 1 ====
test_1 <- expand.grid(
  Type = "genet",

  Marker = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  Level = c("Family"),#,"Genus","Species"),
  Metric = "Reads",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Calcul tabs
test_1$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_1)), function(i) {
  message("Iteration ", i)
  summary_ab_rel(as.list(test_1[i, ]))

test_1$Check_100 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_1)), function(i) {
```

### Replace \< 2% families

```{r}

df_reduced <- df_combined

df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% percent_other("Clade", "Metric", 2)
  })


# Liste des indices correspondant aux différentes sources
source_indices <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

# Appliquer une fonction à chaque élément de la liste df_reduced$Result
df_list <- lapply(seq_along(source_indices), function(i) {
  # Extraire le dataframe correspondant
  df_temp <- df_reduced$Result[[source_indices[i]]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df_temp$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df_temp)
})

# Sélectionner les éléments de df_list à combiner
df_plot_clust <- bind_rows(df_list[c(1, 3, 5, 7)])

# Créer le graphique avec ggplot2
clust <- ggplot(df_plot_clust, aes(x = Source, y = Metric, fill = Clade)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Bota", y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Clade") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) + # Affiche en pourcentage
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Proportion par Clade")



# Sélectionner les éléments de df_list à combiner
df_plot_rar <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2, 4, 6, 7)])

# Créer le graphique avec ggplot2
rar <- ggplot(df_plot_rar, aes(x = Source, y = Metric, fill = Clade)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Bota", y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Clade") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) + # Affiche en pourcentage
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Proportion par Clade")


```

## Correlation tab

### Family Count / NCI

```{r}

# Make tab of configurations
config_1 <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = c(FALSE),
  "g.Marker" = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  "g.Metric" = c("Reads"),
  "b.Metric" = c("Count","NCI"),
  "b.Radius" = c(10),
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Level" = c("Family"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Give common Names
level_names <- give_common_family()

# Correlation Tab
tab_1 <- make_cor_table_bota_genet(config_1, level_names)

# Plot
corr_tab(tab_1)
```
